name: sampler3
title: Flexure sampler 3: a folded guide, a cartwheel pivot, an elliptical hinge, two snap hooks and a ratchet
orientation: Flat on the bed as drawn: everything bends in the plane of the bed, within its layers. 100% infill, 0.2 mm layers. The ratchet wheel is held to the rail by a two-line tab: snap it off, set it on the boss with a 20 mm bit of filament through both, and its teeth meet the pawl's upper half.

height.rule: Every part's width, up from the bed: 40 layers

rail.rule: The rail the parts stand off, along y

spacing.rule: From one part to the next along the rail

overlap.rule: How far a part sits into the rail, so they join

pin_fit.rule: Room round the pin in the boss

boss.rule: The boss's radius round the pin

post.rule: The posts carrying the boss and the catch lips off the rail

loose.rule: The wheel's gap from the rail

tab.rule: The tab holding the wheel to the rail: two lines, to snap off

clearance.rule: The folded guide's shuttle to its posts and base: the travel it can make

end.rule: The folded guide's trusses, posts and base bar

folded_width.rule: The folded guide across: shuttle, clearances, posts, beams and trusses

folded_lift.rule: Lifts the folded guide so its base bar sits in the rail

spoke.rule: The cartwheel's spokes, hub to rim

arm.rule: The cartwheel's arm past the rim: push its end sideways to turn the hub

along.rule: The elliptical hinge's notches along the beam

arms.rule: The elliptical hinge's arms either side of the neck

undercut.rule: The hooks' height off the beam

square.rule: The first hook's back: square, so it holds

sloped.rule: The second hook's back: sloped, so it lets go at a higher force

flat.rule: The hook's flat top, as the generator draws it: the thickness, at least 1 mm

engage.rule: How far the catch's lip overlaps the hook

catch_gap.rule: Between the hook's face and the catch post

gap_above.rule: Between the hook's back and the lip, so they print apart

hook_pitch.rule: From one hook to the next

wheel_radius.rule: The ratchet wheel, to the teeth's tips

tooth.rule: A tooth's height: what the pawl lifts each click

degrees.rule: Degrees in a radian, for the hooks' angles
